search:0:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.
True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

search:0:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
search:0:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned to reincarnation again.
search:0:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: aaveh sache jaaveh sache fir joonee mool na paeh |

search:0:30:source=1:ਤਨਅਜ.translation: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.

search:0:30:source=1:ਲਜਭਭ.translation: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee paae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aavat kau jaataa kahai jaate kau aaeaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aisaa koe ji dubidhaa maar gavaavai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who sees himself as lowly,
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aapas kau jo jaanai neechaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who calls himself good
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aapas kau jo bhalaa kahaavai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He Himself grants His Grace;
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apanee kripaa jis aap karee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He Himself knows His own ways.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apane karatab jaanai aap |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: antar krodh jooai mat haaree |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: alautee kaa jaise bheaa bareddaa jin peea tin jaaniaa |2|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੮੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apanee kudarat jaanai aap |4|31|82|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo lachhamee simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo isatree simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo larrike simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo mandar simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: anik kattak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kehan na aaeaa |3|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape karataa jug jug soe |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aavat karataa jaat bhee karataa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The proud, egotistical person will surely be uprooted. ||7||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: abhimaanee kee jarr sarapar jaae |7|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: asathir kandh japai nirankaaree |3|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape kaaran jin keea kar kirapaa pag dhaar |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: agai kiaa jaanaa naeh mai bhoole too samajhaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jam johi na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he |5|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He alone knows His handiwork.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apunaa keea jaaneh aap |

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਠੇਹ ॥੧॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jam maarai ttheh |1|

search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.
search:0:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape karataa jis no devai tis vasai man aaee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saadhasang pragatte naaraaein |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: samadarasee pooran nirajog |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: suniai pohi na sakai kaal |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satagur purakh na manio sabad na lago piaar |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: so prabh nadar na aavee manamukh boojh na paae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saachee preet na tuttee saache mel milaau |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sadaa pir nihachal paaeeai naa ohu marai na jaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sumat paae naam dhiaae guramukh hoe melaa jeeo |3|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saram pee naaraaeinai naanak dar peeaahu |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the treasure of the Name is obtained.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saadhasang paaeeai nidh naamaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sant prasaad naanak har bhette man tan seetal dhraape |4|14|135|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sach poojee naam drirraae prabh vanajaare thaare |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai aape le jis laae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saran peaa naanak suohelaa |4|9|48|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur purakh na bhettio ji sachee boojh bujhaae |1|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saachee preet na tuttee piaare jug jug rahee samaae |6|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, and has received the blessings of fearlessness and peace. ||2||3||12||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saran pario naanak tthaakur kee abhai daan sukh paaeo |2|3|12|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protected him. ||4||2||32||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saran pario naanak prabh tumaree de raakhio har haath |4|2|32|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: God is the nearest of the near.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: so prabh nerai hoo te nerai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saran pario naanak har duaare |4|4|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saakat prem na paaeeai har paaeeai satigur bhaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sabh paarabraham nadaree aaeaa |2|16|80|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saranee paavan naam dhiaavan sehaj samaavan sang |1| rahaau |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: and live a lifestyle which is true, perfect and spotless. ||2||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saachee pooran niramal reet |2|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sant prasaad nihachal ghar paaeaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur poochh na maarag chaalee sootee rain vihaanee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baah pakar prabh kaadt leaa |2|24|110|

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sur pavitr nar dev pavitraa khin bolahu guramukh baanee |1| rahaau |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੂਆ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sooaa pinjar nahee khaae bilaas |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sevak panch naahee bikh chaakhee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The True Transcendent Lord is always new, forever fresh.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sach paramesar nit navaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The stubborn-minded person does not even like the True Guru; he comes and goes in reincarnation.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur piaaraa na lagee manahatth aavai jaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The True Lord does not grow old; His Naam is never dirtied.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: sach puraanaa naa theeai naam na mailaa hoe |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The Perfect True Guru has bestowed the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur poorai naam deea |

search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantly attuned to the Lord.
search:0:50:source=1:ਸਪਨ.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai nit hiradai har liv laae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: purabe kamaae sreerang paae har mile chiree vichhuniaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: pir kai sehaj rahai rang raatee sabad singaar banaavaniaa |5|

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: pat ke saad khaadaa lahai daanaa kai sir daan |1|

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: paarabraham kee saranee paeh |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: - there, the Saints dwell, in the Company of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: paarabraham ke sangee santaa |3|

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee |1| rahaau |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In God's Sanctuary, everyone is saved.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kee saran ubarai sabh koe |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau sad bal jaaee jeeo |2|

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: preet karahu sad ek siau eaa saachaa asanehu |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran dookh jam nasai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, death is eliminated.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaal paraharai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਟਰੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran dusaman ttarai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran anadin jaagai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran dukh na santaapai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kaa simaran saadh kai sang |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran binasai doojaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran teerath isanaanee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran daragah maanee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran hoe su bhalaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran sufal falaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kaa simaran sabh te aoochaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran udhare moochaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran trisanaa bujhai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran pooran aasaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jaae |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are wealthy.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se dhanavante |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are honorable.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se pativante |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are approved.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se jan paravaan |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se purakh pradhaan |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are not lacking.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh si bemuhataaje |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh si sarab ke raaje |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God dwell in peace.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se sukhavaasee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh sadaa abinaasee |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God generously help others.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se praupakaaree |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin sad balihaaree |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh se mukh suhaave |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God abide in peace.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin sookh bihaavai |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God conquer their souls.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin aatam jeetaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin niramal reetaa |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin anad ghanere |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kau simareh baseh har nere |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaaraj poore |

search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.translation: Remembering God, one never grieves.
search:0:50:source=1:ਪਕਸ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.
True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned to reincarnation again.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: aaveh sache jaaveh sache fir joonee mool na paeh |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: rojaa dharai manaavai alahu suaadat jeea sanghaarai |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: naanak satigur seveh aapanaa se jan sache paravaan |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created, shall also destroy.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: gur giaan apaaraa sirajanahaaraa jin sirajee tin goee |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellished the body with Truth.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: panch bhoo naaeiko aap sirandaa jin sach kaa pindd savaariaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are adorned with the Shabad.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasiaa ghatt antar se jan sabad suhaae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaaeaa thaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: paarabraham aparanpar satigur jis simarat man seetalaaeinaa |10|

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: You are the blissful and infinite Primal Lord God; Your Light is all-pervading.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: too purakh anandee anant sabh jot samaaharaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: The Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master are incomparably beautiful. Meditating on them, one becomes Holy. ||1||Pause||
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: charan kamal anoop suaamee japat saadhoo hoe |1| rahaau |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: Vibrating and meditating continuously on our Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, one's life becomes totally fruitful.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: nit bhajahu suaamee antarajaamee safal janam sabaaeaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸੋਨਾ ॥੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.translation: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be True forever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5||
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਸਜਸ.transliteration: sabh dhiaavahu aad sate jugaad sate paratakh sate sadaa sadaa sate jan naanak daas dasonaa |5|

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.translation: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.transliteration: jaisee bhookh hoe abh antar toon samarath sach devanahaar |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.translation: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.
search:1:30:source=1:ਅਤਸਸਦ.transliteration: jo maageh tthaakur apune te soee soee devai |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸੳਦਕਵ.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸੳਦਕਵ.translation: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸੳਦਕਵ.transliteration: sateea man santokh upajai denai kai veechaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: suniai sat santokh giaan |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: simar simar simar gunataas |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of the World.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saadhoo sang simar gopaal |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saas saas simarahu gobind |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: samund saah sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaah |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache gun gaaveh saachai naae piaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saachau saahib seveeai guramukh akatho kaath |6|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sachaa saahib seveeai guramukh vasai man aae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਸਗਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: simar suaamee sukhah gaamee ichh sagalee puneea |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaattee jam kee faasaa jeeo |2|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saas saas so gun nidh gaaeeai |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sach sanjamo saar gunaa gurasabad kamaaeeai raam |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery and hunger depart. ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sabh sukh sabh gun sabh nidhaan har jit japiai dukh bhukh sabh leh jaaee |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: se sehaj suhele gunah amole jagat udhaaran aae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mind is awakened. ||23||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: simar simar simar gur apunaa soeaa man jaagaaee |23|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; they are attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaaveh sabad rate veechaaree he |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sadaa sabad saalaahee gunadaataa lekhaa koe na mangai taahaa he |9|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: saadh sangen simarant gobind saran naanak har har hare |55|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: The True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: satiguroo satiguroo satigur gubind jeeo |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: so remember that All-powerful Lord with each breath and morsel of food. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: so samarath simar saas giraas |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes one's eternal companion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: naam dhiaaee sadaa sakhaaee sehaj subhaaee govindaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: man ichh paaee prabh dhiaaee sanjog saahaa subh ganiaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: He is blissful, night and day; He is forever True. All Glories are contained in the Lord in the Universe.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: aanand anadin sadaa saachaa sarab gun jagadeesarai |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sad sadaa sinmratabay suaamee saas saas gun bolee |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him, there is no other at all.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: bhaj saran suaamee sukhah gaamee tis binaa an naeh koe |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: tis bin avar na koee sadaa sach soee guramukh eko jaaniaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: sache sandaa sadarraa suneeai gur veechaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.translation: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self. One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਗ.transliteration: antar sabad sadaa sukhadaataa guramukh boojhai koee he |5|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: saach sehaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: sach salaahe sabh ghatt antar sacho sach suhaavaniaa |5|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.
And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: sarab sookh sehaj ghar terai amiau teree drisatteejaa he |7|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace. He is the Cherisher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: eehaa aoohaa sarab sukhadaataa sagal ghattaa pratipaare |1| rahaau |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: sun saasat saudaagaree sat ghorre lai chal |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills all hearts.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: deen deaal kripaal sukh saagar sarab ghattaa bharapooree re |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: jin tum bheje tineh bulaae sukh sehaj setee ghar aau |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: Sing this true song of praise in the true home of your soul.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: ehu saachaa sohilaa saachai ghar gaavahu |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥੩੯॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: Says Nanak, sing the true song of praise in the true home of your soul. ||39||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: kahai naanak sach sohilaa sachai ghar gaavahe |39|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach your true home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: bikharre daau langhaavai meraa satigur sukh sehaj setee ghar jaate |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਸੁ ਸਚਹ ਘਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.translation: One who has the Guru on his side contemplates the Shabad and the Teachings, and abides in the Home of Truth.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਸਘ.transliteration: jaam guroo hoe val sabad saakhee su sachah ghar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: simar simar tis sadaa samaale |1| rahaau |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: sachai sabh taan sachai sabh jor |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: peeearrai sahu sev toon saahurarrai sukh vas |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa toon sahaje sach samaavaniaa |8|16|17|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: jis saadhoo sangat tis sabh sukaranee jeeo |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਸਤਸਸ.transliteration: naanak naam salaeh sadaa too sachai sabad samaeh |4|4|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: sant prasaad naanak har bhette man tan seetal dhraape |4|14|135|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai aape le jis laae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: God is the nearest of the near.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: so prabh nerai hoo te nerai |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4||

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantly attuned to the Lord.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai nit hiradai har liv laae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: man tane galataan simarat prabh naam har amrit peevate jeeo |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: hor birahaa sabh dhaat hai jab lag saahib preet na hoe |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: moh kuttanb siau preet na hoe |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is taken away. ||1||Pause||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: jam kee traas mittee sukh paaeaa nikasee haumai peer |1| rahaau |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves becomes the philosopher's stone; they become the companions of the Lord, the Guru. ||4||4||12||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: paaras bhett bhe se paaras naanak har gur sang thee |4|4|12|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He loves only to slander others.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਪਨਹ.transliteration: naam amolaa preet na tis siau par nindaa hitakaarai |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਭਮੲਸ.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਭਮੲਸ.translation: Whatever God does, I accept that as good. This is the sublime wisdom I have obtained from the Holy. ||2||
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਭਮੲਸ.transliteration: jo prabh keeno so bhal maanio eeh sumat saadhoo te paaee |2|

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਸੳਦਕਵ.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਸੳਦਕਵ.translation: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਸੳਦਕਵ.transliteration: sateea man santokh upajai denai kai veechaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਨਨਕਕਅ.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਨਨਕਕਅ.translation: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.
search:1:30:source=1:ਸਮਨਨਕਕਅ.transliteration: sookham moorat naam niranjan kaaeaa kaa aakaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਟਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਟਕਮਲ.translation: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.
search:1:30:source=1:ਟਕਮਲ.transliteration: lakh ttakiaa ke mundarre lakh ttakiaa ke haar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Your actions seem so sweet to me.

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: tis kee muhataajee lok kadtadaa horat hatt na vath na vesaahu |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: - their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: naam sang taa kaa man laag |4|49|118|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੯੦॥੧੫੯॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: if they enshrine the Lord's Feet within their minds. ||4||90||159||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag |4|90|159|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: aootthat baitthat tthegaa parihai tab kat moodd lukeehai |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai |2|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag |2|7|25|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: - his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||6||8||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: gur charanee taa kaa man laag |4|6|8|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: prabhoo tiaag aan jo chaahat taa kai mukh laagai kaalekhaa |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਕਮਲ.transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laae |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਠਤਪਅ.translation: You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਨਅਜਨ.translation: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਨਅਜਨ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਨਅਜਨ.translation: He is peaceful, and he is the master of all; the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||14||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਨਅਜਨ.transliteration: tis hee sukh tis hee tthakuraaee tiseh na aavai jam nerraa |14|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.translation: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.transliteration: tatee vaau na lagee jin man vutthaa aae jeeo |2|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.translation: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.transliteration: tatee vaau na lagee satigur rakhe aap |3|

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.translation: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the Supreme Lord God.
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.transliteration: taatee vaau na lagee paarabraham saranaaee |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.translation: is not touched by the hot winds.
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.transliteration: tis tatee vaau na lagai kaaee |

search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.translation: Hugging him close in His Embrace, the Lord saves and protects His slave. The hot winds cannot even touch him. ||1||
search:1:30:source=1:ਤਵਨਲ.transliteration: kantth laae apuno daas raakhio taatee vaau na laaeo |1|

search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar |

search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.translation: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge man meh sabad anand |

search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.translation: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.
search:1:30:source=1:ਧਧਰਗ.transliteration: dhan dhan raamadaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa |

search:1:30:source=1:ਨਅਮਅਸ.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

search:1:30:source=1:ਮਬਗਗ.translation: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.

search:1:30:source=1:ਲਜਭਭ.translation: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee paae |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aavat kau jaataa kahai jaate kau aaeaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aisaa koe ji dubidhaa maar gavaavai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who sees himself as lowly,
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aapas kau jo jaanai neechaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who calls himself good
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aapas kau jo bhalaa kahaavai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He Himself grants His Grace;
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apanee kripaa jis aap karee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He Himself knows His own ways.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apane karatab jaanai aap |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: antar krodh jooai mat haaree |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: alautee kaa jaise bheaa bareddaa jin peea tin jaaniaa |2|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੮੨॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apanee kudarat jaanai aap |4|31|82|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jaae |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo lachhamee simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo isatree simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo larrike simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jo mandar simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: anik kattak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kehan na aaeaa |3|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape karataa jug jug soe |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aavat karataa jaat bhee karataa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The proud, egotistical person will surely be uprooted. ||7||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: abhimaanee kee jarr sarapar jaae |7|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: asathir kandh japai nirankaaree |3|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape kaaran jin keea kar kirapaa pag dhaar |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: agai kiaa jaanaa naeh mai bhoole too samajhaae |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jam johi na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he |5|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He alone knows His handiwork.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: apunaa keea jaaneh aap |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਠੇਹ ॥੧॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ant kaal jam maarai ttheh |1|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aape karataa jis no devai tis vasai man aaee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਮਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋਰ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Countless impose their will by force.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: asankh amar kar jaeh jor |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: tis aagai aradaas kar jo mele karataar |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: vasat paraaee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dukh ghaale |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: gur aagai kar jodarree jan naanak har melaae |10|1|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aapeh keea karaaeaa aapeh karanai jog |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: jis andar preet nahee satigur kee su koorree aavai koorree jaavai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਘਾਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: gur satigur agai ko jeeo laae ghaalai tis agai gurasikh kaar kamaavai |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: ab mohi raam apunaa kar jaaniaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree asattapadee kabeer jee kee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: eirraa pingulaa sukhaman bande e avagan kat jaahee |1|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeo kee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do these ignorant people know? ||1||Pause||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: kar masatak dhaar raakhio kar apunaa kiaa jaanai ihu lok ajaanaa |1| rahaau |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements. How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: bhram meh soee sagal jagat dhandh andh | koaoo jaagai har jan |1|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar ki jaanai giaanaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਇੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aaeirrai aap kare jin chhoddee jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: oe ji aaveh aas kar jaeh niraase kit |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: jete daane an ke jeea baajh na koe |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਜਨਾਇ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਿਸਤ ਸਰੀਕੀ ॥੪॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner in heaven. ||4||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: aap janaae avar kau jaanai tab hoe bhisat sareekee |4|

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੈ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: jeevanai kee aas kareh jam nihaarai saasaa |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਮਨਹਠ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: hoe anan manahatth kee drirrataa aapas kau jaanaat |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: He consulted Himself for advice, and what He did came to pass.
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: mataa masoorat aap kare jo kare su hoee |

search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.translation: You shall attain salvation, peace, poise and bliss, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||Pause||
search:1:50:source=1:ਅਕਜ.transliteration: gat paaveh sukh sehaj anandaa kaatte jam ke faahaa |1| rahaau |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran dookh jam nasai |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, death is eliminated.
Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.
Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran dukh na santaapai |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran hoe su bhalaa |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jaae |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one never grieves.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee |

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੋਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.translation: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberation is obtained. ||1||Pause||
search:2:30:source=1:ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ.transliteration: maanukh kau jaachat sram paaeeai prabh kai simaran mokh |1| rahaau |
